text:
Lina: Quick thread on the latency line chart: need to finalize legend position + how we show units (ms vs s) and what to do with spikes.
Sam: Can we try legend above the chart centered? Right side feels disconnected.
Jon: Put it above on desktop, collapse to a single icon on small screens that expands to a list.
Maya: Also think about full labels: "90th (p90) latency" instead of just "p90" so non-ML folks understand.
Lina: Agreed — spell it out then add (p90). Good for onboarding.
Sam: Units: auto-scale makes sense but must never mix units on same axis. Convert whole axis to seconds if median > 1000ms.
Jon: Alternative: keep axis in ms but show an axis suffix toggle (ms / s). Simpler to implement.
Maya: Smoothing: current 5-point EMA hides short regressions. Maybe default to raw + optional smoothing overlay.
Lina: I like raw as thin dotted line + smoothed solid thicker line. Legend shows both with samples.
perf-bot: Note: charting-lib v4 supports dual-lines and sample legend icons. Patch #940 uses that.
Sam: Outliers: default behavior should be show everything. Add a "cap at 99.9th pct" quick filter for cleaner trend view.
Jon: And add a tiny "zoom to outlier" action in tooltip to jump to that window for inspection.
Maya: Accessibility: use colorblind-safe palette (I can share tokens). Also add different stroke patterns for raw vs smoothed for print/mono.
Lina: Tooltips must show raw value + which aggregation shown (e.g., p90 raw, smoothed). No rounding beyond 2 decimals for ms.
Sam: UX copy: replace "p95" with "95th percentile (p95)" in dropdown, and in small screens shorten to p95 only in compact mode.
Jon: One more: offer a log-scale toggle for tail analysis. Document when to use it because it can be confusing.
Maya: I'll update the figma comps: top legend desktop, collapsed icon mobile, raw+smoothed sample keys, unit toggle, outlier cap control.
Lina: TL;DR action list: Maya updates comps, Sam prototypes unit toggle and cap control, Jon adds zoom-to-spike CTA, I'll coordinate copy and accessibility tokens.
perf-bot: CI: chart-tests passed on branch chart-ui/legend-units. Preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/ui/charts/legend-units.
Sam: I'll mock the mobile collapse behavior in the prototype and drop link.
Maya: Will post updated screens by EOD and ping here.
Lina: Thanks team, this feels actionable.
